title: Every central bank the BIS covers: total assets each month, in its own currency and in US dollars
granularity: monthly; history from 1914 for the United States, 1953 for Japan, 1998 for the euro area
source: Bank for International Settlements, central bank total assets (WS_CBTA 1.0)
note: Euro-area member central banks are listed and are also inside the Eurosystem line, so adding every row counts them twice. Own-currency rows are as published; US-dollar rows use the BIS end-of-month exchange rate.
